title: JobTerminalPayload
description: Payload for jobs.terminal durable stream events.

kind.description: Closed vocabulary of job kinds matching backend progress namespaces.

job_id.description: Unique identifier of the job instance.

status.description: Closed vocabulary of terminal job outcomes.

error.description: Error message when status is failed or cancelled; omitted on success.

finished_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the job reached its terminal state.
